en: Our hands-on impressions of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. After 10 hours with the game on Nintendo Switch 2, the tactical battles are the highlight. Between battles, you explore the dungeons to find new weapons and recruit allies. In docked mode, the game runs at 1080p, and in handheld mode it runs at 720p. Either way, the game runs at a locked 30fps. The story starts strong, though the first chapter's ending is a bit disappointing.

CD Projekt Red has cut the price of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Complete Edition for a limited time. The edition includes both expansions, Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine. The game is now $29.99 instead of $59.99 on PlayStation and Xbox, and it costs 149 dirhams on the Steam store in the UAE. The physical edition costs $69.99 and is unaffected by the sale.

Nintendo has released a new clip for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Nintendo Switch 2. The first print run comes with a foil cover while supplies last, so players who pre-order early are more likely to get it. 23 days left until launch: the game arrives on November 5.

Sony made a silent revision inside the PS5 Slim. Teardowns of new units show a smaller motherboard and a redesigned cooling fan, but Sony has not announced the change, and the console's model number has not changed.

Ubisoft says Rainbow Six Mobile will stop on December 1, and in-game purchases have already been disabled. In a separate announcement, the company said the servers of an older multiplayer title will close seven years after launch.

Bandai Namco announced a new Tales game during its showcase, and with a new combat system and a large open world, it is shaping up to be one of next year's biggest launches. Meanwhile, Tales of Arise's free update arrives today on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
